purpose: The data model, workflow states, notifications and engine integrations for the NEX Staircase Project Operating System. Converts a customer idea into a tracked staircase project. Serves both customer and trade sides.
philosophy: Not a dashboard - a full operating system.
One project = one source of truth. Every stage references the same project record.
Never lose a project. If a customer goes silent for 30 days, the project pauses (not deletes) and can resume.
Reuse existing engines. Assessment consumes diagnosis engine + photo rules. Design consumes design recommendation engine. Supplier consumes matching engine. Quote consumes quote engine.
Both sides tracked. Customer journey and trade journey are two views of the same project state.

data_persistence_rules: One project = one canonical record. All stage data hangs off project_id.
Never lose a project. If stalled 30 days, pause (not delete). Notify customer + trade. Offer resume.
All milestone photos + messages persisted permanently per safety_liability evidence rules.
Personal data follows GDPR retention schedule (V2 - not V1 spec).
Trade-side data is aggregated for metrics (avg response time, win rate) but individual project data belongs to the customer.
Customer can export their project history at any time.
Customer can delete their account - project records anonymised, retained for statistical / evidence purposes.
single_source_of_truth_rule: Every field appears once. Assessment records the stair type - design engine reads it from there, not re-detected. Intent profile records budget - quote engine reads it from there, not re-asked. This is enforced by the entity model above.

presentation_priorities_by_intent_profil.note: Intent profile shapes what the customer sees at each stage.
presentation_priorities_by_intent_profil.homeowner_price_first: Show budget option first. Emphasise cost breakdown. Delay premium options.
presentation_priorities_by_intent_profil.homeowner_design_first: Show premium option first. Emphasise materials + finishing. Cost secondary.
presentation_priorities_by_intent_profil.builder_speed_first: Show fastest lead-time suppliers. Emphasise availability. De-emphasise design consultation.
presentation_priorities_by_intent_profil.architect_craftsmanship_first: Show bespoke manufacturers. Emphasise portfolio + technical drawings. Skip kit options.
presentation_priorities_by_intent_profil.designer_style_first: Match style_preference tightly. Show samples + material boards. Multiple design iterations expected.
